title: GoOrganicAfrica Cabo Verde calculator readiness review — Batch 19

administrative_geography.note: Official INE GIS service identifies the CONCELHOS feature layer and Concelho field.

evidence_findings: FAO GIEWS country brief reference date 19 January 2026 gives a preliminary 2025 maize production estimate of about 1,100 tonnes, nearly 40% below the already low previous five-year average. The brief provides no matching harvested-area denominator.
FAO reports local maize retail prices rose by up to 5% from October to December 2025. This is a retail price movement, not an absolute price or farmgate observation.
Resolution 88/2025 establishes the VI General Agricultural Census for 2025–2026; final numeric tables were not located during this review.
FAO AGRISurvey identifies a 2024 farm income, labour and productivity module and a 2025 production methods and environment module; their tabulations/microdata still require retrieval and review.
Resolution 106/2026 approves a greenhouse support programme with 75% subsidy and a CVE 900,000 per-farmer ceiling. This is policy support, not a market price or actual farm cost.
The INE official GIS service confirms a municipality-level CONCELHOS layer; 22 municipalities are listed for regional selection.

criteria.crop_area_production_yield_by_commodity_: partial — historic 2022 estimates and preliminary 2025 maize production; no matched area/yield or final census tables
criteria.dated_local_farmgate_prices_and_units: blocked — retail price movement only; no dated farmgate price levels
criteria.irrigation_water_and_energy_costs: blocked — no municipality-specific tariffs or farm costs
criteria.labour_rates_and_operations: partial — FAO ILP survey module identified; numeric wage/operation data not extracted
criteria.regional_enterprise_budget_and_gross_mar: blocked — no complete municipality-level enterprise budgets
criteria.currency_and_exchange_rate_method: partial — CVE currency known; calculator conversion and rounding not validated
criteria.source_provenance_and_observation_date: partial — official source dates and preliminary status recorded; primary census tables outstanding
criteria.calculator_mapping_and_test_cases: blocked — no validated calculator mapping or country tests

blockers: Extract final VI RGA 2025/2026 municipality-level crop/season area, production and yield tables, including methods, units and observation dates.
Obtain publicly released or authorised 2024 ILP and 2025 PME survey tables for farm income, labour, productivity, production methods and input use.
Resolve the preliminary 2025 maize estimate against final national observations and raw FAOSTAT series; do not derive yield without matching harvested area.
Obtain dated municipality/island-level farmgate prices for calculator commodities; retail prices and percentage movements are not producer prices.
Obtain current farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, labour, irrigation water, pumping energy, machinery, packaging and inter-island transport costs.
Build separate, documented enterprise budgets for rainfed and irrigated systems, then map validated values and add calculator tests.
safeguards: CV remains research-only and not active.
Do not modify the 10 active profiles or calculator formulas.
Do not treat retail prices, subsidy ceilings or national production totals as farmgate prices, input costs or crop yields.
next_step: Request the final VI RGA 2025/2026 results and AGRISurvey tables from INE/MAA, then extract municipality-level crop, input-use and labour observations before building farm budgets.
